# airflow Provider

Provider for airflow version 3.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "airflow" {
  address = "http://myairflow.com"
  username = "adminuser"
  password = "adminpassword"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) The base URL of the Airflow API server.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for Airflow API authentication.
- `username` (String) Username for Airflow API authentication.

### Optional

- `ca_cert` (String) Path to a CA certificate file to verify the Airflow API server's TLS certificate.
